titleEn: The Glory of Kings — The Renewal of David’s Kingdom and the True Faith (ch. 92–93)
part: ch. 92–93 — The Renewal of David’s Kingdom and the True Faith
about: Chapter 92 tells how Azarias and the Israelite company renew David’s kingship at Zion with the anointing and a festival, set the law for the court, and draw the boundaries of the Ethiopian king’s realm. Chapter 93 records the laws and names written down three months after Zion’s arrival, then turns to Rome: its faith, once right, was spoiled by Nestorius and Arius, while Ethiopia holds the true faith of the apostles.

sentences.t: ፺፪ ፡ ኀበ ፡ ሐደሱ ፡ መንግሥቶ ፡ ለዳዊት ።
sentences.l: 92. Where they-renewed kingdom-his for-David
sentences.i: Chapter 92: Where they renewed the kingdom of David
sentences.n: Chapter heading. ኀበ is “where / the place where”; ሐደሱ is the perfect of ሐደሰ “make new,” so the title says where the kingdom was renewed (reading ኀበ as “how” is also possible (?)). መንግሥቶ is መንግሥት “kingdom” + ‑ሁ “his”; ለዳዊት “for David” marks whose kingdom it is.

sentences.t: ወይቤ ፡ አዛርያስ ፡ አምጽኡ ፡ ኢዮቤል ፡ ወንሖር ፡ ኀበ ፡ ጽዮን ፡ ወበህየ ፡ ነሐድስ ፡ መንግሥቶ ፡ ለእግዚእነ ፡ ዳዊት ።
sentences.l: And-said Azarias: Bring-ye Joel and-Nohor to Zion, and-there let-us-renew kingdom-his for-our-lord David.
sentences.i: And Azarias said, “Bring Joel and Nohor to Zion, and there let us renew the kingdom of our lord David.”
sentences.n: Azarias, the priest’s son who came with Menelik from Jerusalem, leads the renewal of David’s reign at Zion (the Ark’s tent). አምጽኡ is a plural command; ነሐድስ (“let us renew”) is a first-person plural wish from the same root as the title. ኢዮቤል and ንሖር are taken as the names Joel and Nohor, otherwise unknown here (?). ወ‑ “and,” ለ‑ marks the person (“for/of David”).

sentences.t: ወነሥአ ፡ ቅብአ ፡ መንግሥትኒ ፡ ምልአ ፡ ቀርን ፡ ወቀብእዎ ፡ ዕፍረተ ፡ ዘውእቱ ፡ ቅብአ ፡ መንግሥት ፤
sentences.l: And-he-took oil-of-kingdom-also, fullness-of horn, and-they-anointed-him ointment which-it oil-of-kingdom;
sentences.i: And he also took the oil of kingship, a hornful, and they anointed him with ointment, that is, the oil of kingship;
sentences.n: The anointing, as of David by Samuel (1 Samuel 16:13), with the horn of oil. ‑ኒ on መንግሥትኒ is a small “also.” ምልአ ቀርን is “the fill of a horn,” a construct chain. The subject shifts from one man (ነሥአ “he took”) to many (ቀብእዎ “they anointed him”); ዕፍረተ ዘውእቱ ቅብአ መንግሥት, “ointment, which is the oil of kingship,” is the text’s own gloss (?).

sentences.l: And-they-blew horn and-ብዕዛ and-drum and-lyre and-harp and-all play and-song which-with horse and-shield and-bow; and-all male and-female people-of land-of Ethiopia, small-their and-great-their, and-small-ones black-ones, by-each-6000, and-daughters virgins whom chose Azarias from-daughters-of Zion who-by-law, who walks king David when he-goes-up to-Qefaz for-lunch and-for-supper in-inside-of tent-of kingdom;
sentences.i: And they blew the horn, and the ብዕዛ (a wind instrument? (?)), and the drum, the lyre, and the harp, and every kind of play and song, with horse and shield and bow; and all, men and women, the people of the land of Ethiopia, their small and their great, and the lesser dark-skinned ones, in companies of six thousand (?), and virgin daughters whom Azarias chose from the daughters of Zion according to the law, among whom King David walks (?) when he goes up to Qefaz (?) for the midday meal and the evening meal in the tent of the kingdom;
sentences.n: A long list of the festival: instruments, games with horse, shield and bow, and the whole population in order. Uncertain points: ብዕዛ is not clear to me, perhaps a pipe or trumpet (?); በበ፷፻ is “each by 60 × 100,” read as six thousand (?); ቄፋዝ looks like a place or hall name (?); እለ ይከይድ ንጉሥ ዳዊት is awkward, “those among whom / before whom King David walks” (?). ተውኔት “play, spectacle,” ማኅሌት “choral song.” This unit is 45 words and has no ፤ inside to cut at.

sentences.t: ወከመዝ ፡ ተሐደሰ ፡ መንግሥቱ ፡ ለዳዊት ፡ ወልደ ፡ ሰሎሞን ፡ ንጉሠ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ በሀገረ ፡ ምስፍና ፡ በደብረ ፡ ማክዳ ፡ በቤተ ፡ ጽዮን ፡ ኀበ ፡ ተገብረ ፡ ቀዳሚ ፡ ሕግ ፡ ለንጉሠ ፡ ኢትዮጵያ ፤
sentences.l: And-thus was-renewed kingdom-his for-David son-of Solomon king-of Israel, in-city-of rule, in-mount-of Makeda, in-house-of Zion, where was-made first law for-king-of Ethiopia;
sentences.i: And so the kingdom of David, son of Solomon, king of Israel, was renewed in the city of rule, on Mount Makeda, in the House of Zion, where the first law for the king of Ethiopia had been made;
sentences.n: The new David is Menelik, who is given his father’s throne-name and the Davidic kingship here. ምስፍና (“rule, authority”) names the seat, on the hill called after Makeda, the Queen of Sheba, with the house of the Ark. ተሐደሰ is the passive of the same verb as the heading (ሐደሰ); ኀበ again means “where.”

sentences.t: ወእምዝ ፡ ሶበ ፡ ፈጸመ ፡ ዘተገብረ ፡ ሕግ ፡ ወበከመ ፡ ርእዩ ፡ በኢየሩሳሌም ፡ ገብሩ ፡ በቤተ ፡ ጽዮን ፡ ሕገ ፡ ለኅሩያነ ፡ መንግሥት ፡ ወለእለ ፡ ውስጥ ፡ ወለእለ ፡ አፍአ ፡ ወለሕዝብ ፡ ወለአላዳስ ፡ ወለአህጉር ፡ ወለበሓውርት ፡ ወለኵሉ ፡ ሕዘቢሆ ፡ ሙ ፡ ወአንጋዲሆሙ ፡ ከመዝ ፡ ሠርዑ ።
sentences.l: And-then when he-finished what was-made law, and-according-as saw-they in-Jerusalem made-they in-house-of Zion law for-chosen-ones-of kingdom, and-for-those inside and-for-those outside, and-for-people and-for-አላዳስ and-for-cities and-for-በሓውርት and-for-all peoples-their and-merchants-their thus they-ordained.
sentences.i: And then, when what had been made law was completed, and just as they had seen in Jerusalem, they made in the House of Zion a law for the chosen ones of the kingdom, for those within and those outside, for the people, for the አላዳስ (?), for the cities, for the በሓውርት (?), and for all their peoples and their traders (?); so they ordained.
sentences.n: The court now sets up a law copied from the Jerusalem pattern. Note: the source prints ሕዘቢሆ ፡ ሙ with a stray wordspace; it is ሕዘቢሆሙ “their peoples” (ሕዝብ, plural ሕዘብ, + ‑ሆሙ). Uncertain: አላዳስ and በሓውርት are not clear to me (classes of people or regions? (?)); አንጋዲሆሙ is taken as the plural of ንጋድ “merchant, traveller” (?). ሠርዑ is ሠርዐ “set in order, ordain.” ለ‑ before each group means “for.”

sentences.l: And-thus the-boundaries-of land-of kingdom-his for-king-of Ethiopia: eastern, beginning-of city-of Gaza in-land-of Judah which-it Jerusalem, and-boundary-its sea-of Jericho, and-it-passes along-shore-of its-sea to Liba and-Saba, and-descends boundary-its to Bisis and-Asnet, and-boundary-its land-of black-ones and-Uruqan, and-it-goes-up mount Kebereneyon into sea-of darkness which-it west-of sun, and-it-crosses boundary-its to Phenuel and-to-Sifala, and-boundary-its regions-of garden, prosperity-of grain and-abundance-of cattle and-Phoenicia, and-boundary-its to Zawl, and-it-passes sea-of India, and-boundary-its to sea-of Tarshish, and-in-measure-its land-of Midian until it-reaches land-of Gaza, and-boundary-its where first it-began;
sentences.i: And these are the boundaries of the land of the kingdom of the king of Ethiopia: from the east, starting at the city of Gaza in the land of Judah, that is Jerusalem; its border is the sea of Jericho, and it passes along the shore of the sea to Liba and Saba; and its border goes down to Bisis and Asnet; and its border is the land of the dark-skinned peoples and the ʿUruqan (?); and it goes up Mount Kebereneyon into the sea of darkness, that is, the west; and its border crosses to Phenuel and Sifala (?); and its border is the regions of the garden, fertile in grain and rich in cattle, and Phoenicia (?); and its border goes to Zawl (?), and it passes the sea of India, and its border reaches the sea of Tarshish, and by its measure the land of Midian, until it comes to the land of Gaza; and its border returns to where it first began;
sentences.n: The claimed frontiers of the Ethiopian king’s realm, drawn as a circuit that closes on Gaza. This is one 76-word unit because the text has no ፤ inside it; the ወ‑ clauses could be cut but would not end at a mark. ሞጻእት “going-out, boundary” returns with each clause (ሞጻእቱ “its boundary”). ሠረቃዊ “eastern” (from ሠረቀ “rise”). ባሕረ ጽልመት, the “sea of darkness,” is the western ocean. Place names are given in Geʿez form and several I cannot identify: Liba and Saba (Libya and Sheba? (?)), Bisis, Asnet, ዕሩቃን, ኬቤሬኔዮን, ሲፋላ, ዛውል (all (?)); ፌኔኤል may be Peniel (Genesis 32:30) or Phoenicia (?). አግዋረ ገነት “regions of the garden” and መስመረ እክል “thriving of grain” are my best reading (?). ትትኃለፍ and ተዐዲ are “it passes / crosses.”

sentences.l: And-thus the-appointment-of king-of Ethiopia for-him and-for-seed-his until for-ever.
sentences.i: And such is the appointment of the king of Ethiopia, for him and for his descendants for ever.
sentences.n: Closing line of the chapter, marked by the five ፨ signs. ሢመት “appointment, investiture” (the king’s office); ሎቱ “for him”; ዘርኡ “his seed.”

sentences.t: ፺፫ ፡ በእንተ ፡ ዘአማሰኑ ፡ ሃይማኖተ ፡ ሮም ።
sentences.l: 93. Concerning those-who-ruined faith-of Rome.
sentences.i: Chapter 93: Concerning those who ruined the faith of Rome
sentences.n: Chapter heading. በእንተ “concerning”; ዘአማሰኑ is ዘ‑ “those who / that which” + the perfect of አማሰነ “ruin, destroy”; ሃይማኖተ ሮም is a construct chain, “faith-of Rome.” The Rome here is the Christian empire, whose Church the Ethiopian text says went wrong.

sentences.l: And-after they-stayed three-months since came Zion into land-of Ethiopia, on-day rose first month by-speech-of Hebrews, and-in-Greek Tarmon, and-in-Geez Miyazya, on-day 6, and-they-wrote-them these laws and-names and-they-placed-them for-remembrance for-last days, by-which is-done law for-tent and-by-which is-known glory-of kings-of Ethiopia and-glory-of kings-of Rome;
sentences.i: And after they had stayed three months, since Zion had come into the land of Ethiopia, on the day that the first month began (as the Hebrews call it; in Greek Tarmon, and in Geʿez Miyazya), on the sixth, they wrote down these laws and names and set them up as a memorial for the last days, by which the law of the Tent may be carried out, and by which the glory of the kings of Ethiopia and the glory of the kings of Rome may be known;
sentences.n: The date given is Miyazya 6 (April); the Hebrew month name is not actually in the text, so the phrase is just “in the speech of the Hebrews” (?). ፫አውራኀ is “three months” with the numeral written onto the noun. ወጸሐፍዎን ለእሉ ሕግ: ‑ዎን is “them” (feminine plural, picking up ሕግ ወአስማት). ደብተራ is the Tent, the dwelling of the Ark. በዘ… means “by that which…” ; ይትገበር and ይትዐወቅ are passives of ገብረ “do” and አእመረ/ዐወቀ “know.”

sentences.t: እስመ ፡ አኀው ፡ እሙንቱ ፡ ወበአሚነ ፡ ክርስቶስኒ ፤
sentences.l: for brothers they, and-in-belief-of Christ-also;
sentences.i: for they are brothers, and also in belief in Christ;
sentences.n: The Ethiopian and Roman kings are called brothers: the first claim of the chapter. አኀው is “brothers”; አሚነ ክርስቶስ “belief in Christ” (a construct chain); ‑ኒ again “also.”

sentences.t: ቀዳሚሰ ፡ ርቱዐ ፡ አምነ ፡ በስብከተ ፡ ሐዋርያት ፡ እስከ ፡ ቈስጠንጢኖስ ፡ ወእሌኒ ፡ ንግሥት ፡ ዘአውፅአት ፡ ዕፀ ፡ መስቀል ፤
sentences.l: At-first rightly he-believed in-preaching-of apostles until Constantine and-Helena queen who-brought-out wood-of cross;
sentences.i: At first they believed rightly, in the preaching of the apostles, until Constantine and Queen Helena, who brought out the wood of the Cross;
sentences.n: ቀዳሚሰ “at first” (‑ሰ marks a contrast with what follows). The verb አምነ is singular “he believed,” with the Roman Church or empire understood; I give it as “they” (?). Helena, mother of Constantine, is credited with finding the True Cross; ዘአውፅአት “who brought out” is feminine (አውፅአ “bring out”). ዕፀ መስቀል, “wood of the cross.”

sentences.t: ወነበሩ ፡ ፻ወ፴ ፡ ዓመት ፡ ወእምድኅሬሁ ፡ ተንሥአ ፡ ሰይጣን ፡ ዘእምትካት ፡ ዕድዉ ፡ ለሰብእ ፡ ወአስሐቶሙ ፡ ለሰብአ ፡ ብሔረ ፡ ሮሜ ፡ ወአሕሠምዋ ፡ ለሃይማኖተ ፡ ክርስቶስ ፡ ወአምጽኡ ፡ ኑፋቄ ፡ ላዕለ ፡ ቤተ ፡ ክርስቲያን ፡ ዘእግዚኣብሔር ፡ በአፈ ፡ ንስጥሮስ ፤
sentences.l: And-they-stayed 130 year, and-after-it arose Satan who-from-first enemy for-man, and-misled-them the-people-of land-of Rome, and-spoiled-it the-faith-of Christ, and-brought-in heresy upon church-of God by-mouth-of Nestorius;
sentences.i: And they stayed so for 130 years, and after that Satan arose, who from the beginning was the enemy of man, and he led astray the people of the land of Rome, and spoiled the faith of Christ, and brought heresy upon the Church of God through the mouth of Nestorius;
sentences.n: The turn to the story of the fall of Rome’s faith. ፻ወ፴ is “100 and 30.” ዘእምትካት is read as “from the first / from of old” (?); ዕድው “enemy.” አስሐቶሙ “he led them astray,” አሕሠምዋ “he spoiled it” (the ‑ዋ is feminine, for ሃይማኖት); ኑፋቄ “heresy.” በአፈ is “by the mouth of” (construct of አፍ “mouth”), so Nestorius is the speaker through whom Satan works. The 130 years is the text’s own count.

sentences.t: ወንስጥሮስ ፡ ወአርዮስ ፡ ወይባሶ ፡ እለ ፡ ወደየ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ልቦሙ ፡ ዘወደየ ፡ ቅንአተ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ልቡ ፡ ለቀየን ፡ ከመ ፡ ይቅትል ፡ እኁሁ ፡ አቤልሃ ፤
sentences.l: And-Nestorius and-Arius and-Yibaso, those he-put into heart-their what he-put, envy into heart-his for-Cain that he-might-kill brother-his Abel;
sentences.i: And Nestorius and Arius and Yibaso (?), into whose hearts he put the very thing he put, envy, into the heart of Cain, that he might kill his brother Abel;
sentences.n: Three heretics named as Satan’s instruments, like Cain (Genesis 4). ይባሶ is not a name I can identify (?). The relative clause is compressed: እለ ወደየ ውስተ ልቦሙ ዘወደየ… is “those into whose hearts he put (the same) that he put…” ; ቅንአት “envy, zeal.” The ‑ሃ on አቤልሃ is unexplained (?). ከመ ይቅትል “that he might kill” (ከመ + jussive).

sentences.t: ወከማሁ ፡ ወደየ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ልቦሙ ፡ አቡሆሙ ፡ ዲያብሎስ ፡ ጸራ ፡ ለጽድቅ ፡ ወጸላኤ ፡ ሠናያት ፤
sentences.l: And-likewise he-put into heart-their father-their the-devil enemy for-righteousness and-hater-of good-things;
sentences.i: And likewise their father the Devil put into their hearts enmity against righteousness and hatred of good things;
sentences.n: “Their father the Devil” echoes John 8:44. ጸራ and ጸላኤ are both “enemy / hater”; I read them as accusatives of result, “to be enemies of righteousness and haters of good things,” compressed to nouns in English (?). ወደየ “put,” the same verb as the last unit.

sentences.t: በከመ ፡ ይቤ ፡ ዳዊት ፡ ወነበቡ ፡ ዐመፃ ፡ ውስተ ፡ አርያም ፡ ወአንበሩ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ሰማይ ፡ አፉሆሙ ፡ ወአንሶሰወ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ምድር ፡ ልሳኖሙ ፡ ዘለሊሆሙ ፡ ኢያእመሩ ፡ እምኀበ ፡ መጽኡ ፡ ወኢያእመሩ ፡ ኀበ ፡ የሐውሩ ፡ ለፈጣሪሆሙ ፡ በልሳኖሙ ፡ ይውሕኩ ፡ ወይፀርፉ ፡ ላዕለ ፡ ስብሐቲሁ ፡ እንዘ ፡ አምላክ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ ቃለ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፤
sentences.l: As said David: and-they-spoke iniquity on-high, and-they-set in-heaven mouths-their, and-it-wandered on earth tongues-their; of-themselves not-knew-they from-where came-they and-not-knew-they where go-they; against-creator-their with-tongues-their they-mock and-they-blaspheme against glory-his while God he Word-of God;
sentences.i: As David said: “And they spoke iniquity on high, and set their mouths in heaven, and their tongues roamed on the earth.” They themselves did not know where they had come from, and did not know where they are going; against their Creator they mock with their tongues and blaspheme against his glory, though he is God, the Word of God;
sentences.n: Quotes Psalm 73:8–9 (Hebrew numbering; 72 in the Greek and Ethiopic counting): the arrogant set their mouth against heaven while their tongue walks through the earth. The words after “roamed on the earth” are the author’s own application to the heretics. አንሶሰወ “wander about”; ዘለሊሆሙ “of themselves.” ይውሕኩ is read “they mock / slander” (?); ይፀርፉ “they blaspheme.” በከመ ይቤ “as he said” introduces the quotation; እንዘ “while, although.” ቃለ እግዚኣብሔር is Christ as the Word (John 1:1).

sentences.t: ወረደ ፡ እመንበረ ፡ መለኮቱ ፡ ወለብሰ ፡ ሥጋ ፡ አዳም ፡ ወእግዚኣብሔር ፡ ውእቱ ፡ ቃል ፡ ወበይእቲ ፡ ሥጋ ፡ ተሰቅለ ፡ ከመ ፡ ይቤዝዎ ፡ ለአዳም ፡ በዕልወቱ ፡ ወዐርገ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ሰማይ ፡ ወነበረ ፡ ዲበ ፡ መንበረ ፡ መለኮቱ ፡ በይእቲ ፡ ሥጋ ፡ እንተ ፡ ነሥአ ፡ ወካዕበ ፡ ይመጽእ ፡ በስብሐት ፡ ይኴንን ፡ ሕያዋነ ፡ ወሙታነ ፡ ወይፈድዮ ፡ ለኵሉ ፡ በከመ ፡ ምግባሩ ፡ ለዓለመ ፡ ዓለም ፡ አሜን ፡ ወንሕነሰ ፡ ነአምን ፡ ከመዝ ፡ ወንገኒ ፡ ለቅድስት ፡ ሥላሴ ፤
sentences.l: He-came-down from-throne-of divinity-his and-put-on flesh-of Adam, and-God he the-Word, and-in-that flesh was-crucified that they-redeem Adam from-his-ዕልወት, and-ascended into heaven and-sat upon throne-of divinity-his in-that flesh which he-took, and-again he-comes in-glory, he-judges living-ones and-dead-ones and-he-repays-him to-all according-to deed-his for-world-of world Amen. And-we indeed we-believe thus and-we-confess the-Holy Trinity;
sentences.i: He came down from the throne of his divinity and put on the flesh of Adam, and he is God, the Word, and in that flesh he was crucified so that Adam might be redeemed from his ዕልወት (fall? (?)); and he ascended into heaven and sat on the throne of his divinity in that flesh which he took, and he will come again in glory to judge the living and the dead, and will repay each according to his deeds, for ever and ever, Amen. As for us, we believe thus and confess the Holy Trinity;
sentences.n: A creed in miniature: incarnation, crucifixion, ascension, return and judgment (compare the Nicene Creed). This is 47 words, just over the usual cut, but it has no ፤ inside to cut at. ከመ ይቤዝዎ is “that they / one may redeem him” (an impersonal plural) (?). በዕልወቱ is unclear: perhaps ዕልወት “perversity, fall” (?). ለዓለመ ዓለም “for the world of the world,” the standard “for ever and ever.” ‑ሰ in ወንሕነሰ marks the contrast “as for us.” ንገኒ “we confess.”

sentences.t: ወእለሰ ፡ ኢየአምኑ ፡ ከመዝ ፡ ውጉዛን ፡ እሙንቱ ፡ በቃለ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፡ ንጉሠ ፡ ሰማያት ፡ ወምድር ፡ በዝ ፡ ዓለም ፡ ወበዘይመጽእ ፡ ዓለም ፤
sentences.l: And-those-indeed not-believe thus accursed they by-word-of God king-of heavens and-earth in-this world and-in-which-comes world;
sentences.i: But those who do not believe thus are accursed by the word of God, king of heaven and earth, in this world and in the world to come;
sentences.n: ውጉዛን is the plural of “excommunicated, anathematized”; the word of God is the sentence of condemnation. ሰማያት is plural “heavens.” በዘይመጽእ ዓለም “in the one that comes, the world.”

sentences.t: ወንሕነሰ ፡ ጸናዕነ ፡ በርትዕት ፡ ሃይማኖት ፡ እንተ ፡ አበው ፡ ሐዋርያት ፡ ወአወፈዩነ ፡ ሃይማኖተ ፡ እንተ ፡ ቤተ ፡ ክርስቲያን ፤
sentences.l: And-we-indeed we-stood-firm in-right faith which fathers apostles, and-they-gave-us faith which church;
sentences.i: But we stand firm in the right faith of the fathers, the apostles, and they gave us the faith of the Church;
sentences.n: ጸናዕነ “we stood firm” (the perfect, used as a present statement). አበው ሐዋርያት, “fathers, apostles,” are in apposition. አወፈዩነ is አወፈየ “give, deliver” + ‑ነ “us.” እንተ is the relative “which, of” (feminine to match ሃይማኖት).

sentences.t: ወከማሁ ፡ ትነብር ፡ ኢትዮጵያ ፡ ምስለ ፡ ሃይማኖታ ፡ እስከ ፡ ምጽአተ ፡ እግዚእነ ፡ ኢየሱስ ፡ ክርስቶስ ፡ ዘሎቱ ፡ ስብሐት ፡ ለዓለመ ፡ ዓለም ፡ አሜን ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨
sentences.l: And-likewise she-will-remain Ethiopia with faith-her until coming-of our-lord Jesus Christ whose-to-him glory for-world-of world Amen.
sentences.i: And in the same way Ethiopia will remain with her faith until the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ, to whom be glory for ever and ever. Amen.
sentences.n: The close of the chapter, marked by seven ፨ signs. Ethiopia is spoken of as a woman (ትነብር “she remains,” ሃይማኖታ “her faith”). ዘሎቱ ስብሐት is “whose is the glory,” the doxology’s “to whom be glory.”
